**Room:** I — The Guildhall of Gracious Crimes

**The clause (verbatim, front):**

> The Guild shall furnish the party with one (1) complimentary torch, to be collected at the door. The party agrees to proceed by torchlight. Unused equipment remains Guild property. Heroes who return without the torch shall be billed replacement cost. Heroes who return WITH the torch shall be billed for wear.
